heading: Substation Hardened Industrial Computer

text: Designed to withstand the stresses of substation environments, the H500 provides a reliable platform to run Windows applications for industrial and utility applications that fit into a company’s existing Windows environment. With its modern and robust design, the H500 is designed for rugged computing needs and mission critical applications, where high-performance processing and reliable operations are required.
